Performers
Hartford Symphony Orchestra (orchestra), Fritz Mahler (conductor) Documented

Credited on the Vanguard sleeve and in the item metadata; individual players are not identified.

[1] [2]
Work version
Copland’s 1957 orchestral version of Piano Variations (1930) Documented

The sleeve and selected track identify Orchestral Variations, 1957. This is not Variations on a Shaker Melody. The performing edition and parts are unknown.

[2] [4]
Recorded
Unknown Unknown

1961 is the carrier publication year. The consulted sleeve and item metadata do not establish a recording-session date.

[1] [2]
Place
Unknown Unknown

No recording venue is established; Hartford in the ensemble name is not treated as a session location.

[1] [2]
Label
Vanguard Stereolab Documented

Stereo vinyl LP, coupled with Bloch’s Three Jewish Poems and Copland’s Fanfare.

[1] [2]
Catalogue
VSD-2085 Documented

The specific transferred US carrier is catalogued as a 1961 release.

[1] [2]
Matrix, take, sides
Side 2, band 2 Documented

Side and band follow the segmented filename and programme order. Matrix, take and stamper identifiers are unknown.

[3] [2]
Transfer
Internet Archive LP transfer Documented

Institutional transfer credit; no independently established personal mastering credit.

[1]
Transfer date
2021-09-20 Documented

From ripping_date 20210920231659; scan, upload and derivative-generation dates are separate events.

[1]
Processing
Technics SL1200MK5 with Audio-⁠Technica AT95e cartridge → Radio Design Labs EZ-PH1 phono preamp → Focusrite Scarlett 2i2; segmented VBR MP3 derivative Documented

Equalisation, noise reduction, pitch correction and other restoration settings are unknown.

[1] [3]
Composition rights
Copland’s composition and 1957 orchestration remain copyrighted; permissions administered by Boosey & Hawkes Documented

The publisher lists worldwide rights. The recording’s historical publication supplies no permission to reproduce the composition, orchestration or current score.

[4] [8] [7]
Recording rights
Territorial EU phonogram public-domain basis: commercial publication in 1961, before 1963 Inferred, not documented

Under the project’s eu-published-before-1963 rule, the carrier’s former 50-year phonogram term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is not a US-government recording, a Creative Commons licence, US public-domain status or worldwide clearance. Composition rights remain separate.

Aaron Copland, Orchestral Variations; Hartford Symphony Orchestra, Fritz Mahler. Vanguard VSD-2085 (1961 issue), Internet Archive LP transfer. Territorial EU phonogram basis only; composition and orchestration remain copyrighted.
